loginFailedGeneric: Login failed. Check your connection and try again.
accountLocked: Too many failed login attempts for this account. Try again in a few minutes.
accountDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
resetIntro: Enter your account's email address. If an account exists, a new password will be emailed to it.
resetConfirmation: If an account with this address exists, a new password has been emailed to it. Check your inbox.
resetThrottled: Only one reset request per minute is allowed for an address. Try again shortly.
resetUnavailable: Password reset is not available on this deployment. Contact your administrator.
resetFailedGeneric: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
mfaExplainer: We've emailed a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to finish signing in.
mfaInvalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Sign in again to get a new one.
mfaTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
mfaUnavailable: Your account requires a sign-in code by email, but this deployment cannot send email. Contact your administrator.
